status.en: 18 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, most of them in Mogadishu, Baidoa and Puntland.
status.nb: 18 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, flest i Mogadishu, Baidoa og Puntland.

summary.en: Al-Shabaab fighters are intensifying attacks on Somali army units, including a clash with Turkish-trained troops and a deadly convoy ambush that killed many soldiers. The army also faced mortar shelling in Puntland that killed three civilians and wounded seven, and heavy losses were reported after a battle in Jameeca. Somalia denied that Turkish F‑16 aircraft struck its own positions during the clashes. The conflict produced 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Al-Shabaab-krigere intensiverer angrep på somaliske hærstyrker, inkludert en sammenstøt med tyrkisk-trente tropper og et dødelig bakholdsangrep på en konvoi som drepte mange soldater. Hæren ble også utsatt for morterild i Puntland som drepte tre sivile og såret sju, og store tap ble rapportert etter en kamp i Jameeca. Somalia benektet at tyrkiske F‑16‑fly rammet egne posisjoner under sammenstøtene. Konflikten førte til 2 284 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.extract: The ongoing phase of the Somali Civil War began in 2009 and is concentrated in southern and central Somalia, primarily between the forces of the Federal Government of Somalia (FGS), assisted by African Union peacekeeping forces, and the Islamist militant group al-Shabaab, which pledged allegiance to al-Qaeda in 2012.
